ideas.pitch: An automated defense-in-depth security tool designed to harden LLM instructions against multi-turn jailbreaks and prompt injection exploits.
ideas.problem_statement: Zero Day Apocalypse: How Far Can You Push an AI? What happens when an AI is told not to do something? Your job is to make it do exactly that.
ideas.title: PromptDefender Studio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages defense-in-depth principles proven in past personal agent challenge winners, addressing the exact inverse of the competition's prompt injection challenge.
